Why Trust CrossVerification

Official Sources Only

We verify claims using government websites, PIB, RTI data and trusted news agencies only.

Unbiased & Neutral

No political bias. We follow strict editorial guidelines to deliver objective, fact-based verdicts.

Most claims are investigated and published within 24 hours of submission.

Community Driven

Readers like you submit claims daily — together we fight misinformation across India.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is CrossVerification?
CrossVerification is India's digital truth platform. We fact-check viral news, government schemes, job alerts, and expose online scams to help you verify before believing.
How do you verify claims?
We receive the claim, investigate using official sources (government websites, PIB, news agencies), gather evidence, and publish a verdict — True, False, or Misleading.
Can I submit a claim?
Yes! Forward any viral message, news story, or suspicious claim via our Submit a Claim page or WhatsApp. Our team will investigate and publish findings.
Is CrossVerification free?
Absolutely. All fact-check articles, scam alerts, and verification reports are completely free to read and share. Our mission — make truth accessible to everyone.
